crawlMethod: Public browser-rendered result tables; exact source names and numeric text preserved.

finalization.activePeriodPolicy: Periods after finalizedThrough remain CURRENT / INCOMPLETE / NOT IMPORTABLE until the source manifest is explicitly advanced after final standings are published.
finalization.currentPeriodReason: August 2026 is the active Monthly and is not finished; its scores, points, placements, totals, HN1, and standings are not final historical results.

notes: The public page exposed up to ten displayed rows per course table; no hidden rows were present in the rendered table HTML during this crawl.
2024 January through July rendered no course rows; those periods are covered by navigation but contribute no score observations.
The duplicated January/February navigation cycle after 2024 January was excluded after repeated URLs/blank pages were detected.
Historical rank is not inferred from current website state; only the displayed period placement and standings fields are included.
